summary: The global marketing team is juggling urgent technical fixes, a major knowledge website redesign, and a strategic pivot to prioritize China-based programs like Asia Start and Intelligent China.
summaryDetail: Immediate attention is required to resolve the Outlook account lockout that has disrupted team access, with steps to reset passwords and re-login on all devices, and confirmation from JSB about the backend lock. In parallel, the knowledge website redesign is advancing: the team agreed to keep the current look and feel while integrating more articles and indices from Joseph's alternative layout, and Joseph, Julie, and Joker are meeting to finalize feedback and implement changes. Strategically, the team is focusing on China-based programs (Asia Start and Intelligent China) for SEO and marketing, with Joseph drafting a plan, the team analyzing participant profiles, and auditing conversion tracking; US programs are on hold except Berkeley as a potential third priority. Upcoming items include Ira's draft email to IE University about the CKGSB-IE report, review of the Katya Asia Start spotlight article, and preparation for the AmCham Shanghai Sustainability Awards, while the CKGSB newsletter 'Selling more, keeping less' goes out today and a call with UN Women is scheduled for Tuesday.

meetings.title: Knowledge Website Design Review
meetings.summary: The team reviewed the current knowledge website design and Joseph's alternative layout, agreeing the current design is largely similar to the existing site with the main change being menu categorization. They discussed incorporating more articles and indices from Joseph's version while keeping the current look and feel.

meetings.title: CKGSB Global Marketing Strategy Meeting
meetings.summary: The team discussed prioritizing China-based programs (Asia Star and Intelligent China) for SEO and marketing, with a focus on understanding target audience and conversion tracking. They agreed to draft a plan, audit existing tracking, and consider US programs as secondary.
